confidence_notes: Nagasaki-specific aggregate prices support the meal, cappuccino, and draft-beer estimates, though coverage is limited. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated relative to local draft beer. Accommodation estimates are less certain and based on general knowledge; no live booking listings were inspected.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and coffee anchors use Nagasaki-specific typical-price observations. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of regional Japanese cities with tourism demand.
